title: Special repairs and Civil Maintenance of Lighthouse Tower, Staff Quarters, Compound wall etc at Mallipattinam Lighthouse
summary: E-tender for special repairs and civil maintenance of the lighthouse tower, staff quarters and compound wall at Mallipattinam Lighthouse, Thanjavur district, Tamil Nadu, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai; a corrigendum converted it from item rate to percentage rate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Mallipattinam Lighthouse, Mallipattinam, Thanjavur District, Tamilnadu
sites.work: Special repairs and civil maintenance of lighthouse tower, staff quarters, compound wall

scope.item: Special repairs and Civil Maintenance of Lighthouse Tower, Staff Quarters, Compound wall etc.

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. Tender fee Nil. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalised bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai, valid three months from technical bid opening; originals by 18.07.2024 15:00.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category & class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies

Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80%; only fully completed works with completion certificate; values enhanced at 7% simple per annum; certificates below Executive Engineer rank not considered
Similar works: repairs and civil maintenance of building or construction of any type of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work
PAN/ITCC/GST registration; key technical personnel for supervision and execution
Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III); tender acceptance letter (Annexure II); affidavit/self-attestation of not being blacklisted
List of relatives serving in MoPSW/DGLL; Make in India self-certification (Annexure VI)

corrigenda.change: Technical corrigendum: item rate in schedule of work to be read as percentage rate; added percentage-rate conditions to GCC (quote % above/below in figures and words; tie-break by revised sealed offers then draw of lots; 50% EMD forfeiture for refusing revised offer); SCC item 40 revised: excess quantity up to +15% at agreement rate, beyond that and extra/substituted items per CPWD analysis of rates and Works Manual.

unreadable: Hindi text layer partly garbled (font mojibake); English portions read

notes: Section-I NIT only; no BOQ. NIT dated 09/07/2024 but download/submission period starts 20.06.2024 (NIT re-issued with same date as corrigendum; Tender ID suffix _2). Download/submission 20.06.2024 15:00 to 18.07.2024 15:00; opening 19.07.2024 15:00.
